_comment: English body for prompt-case-repro-checklist. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output data, code, environment and metric checks; state not reproduced when applicable.
Inputs: Paper abstract, official repository, and experimental setup.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Generate a reproduction checklist. Output checks[] with item, source, status (verified/missing/unknown), and note. source points to paper/repository text; if nothing was actually run, runtime items are unknown and marked not reproduced. Reading code is not reproduction.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.检查点:
- Unrun runtime items are unknown.
- Sources can be traced.
- A not-reproduced statement is explicit.
sections.失败分支:
- Missing repository: mark missing.
- Unclear metric basis: list unknown.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
